verses.he: כַּשֶּׁ֤לֶג׀ בַּקַּ֗יִץ וְכַמָּטָ֥ר בַּקָּצִ֑יר כֵּ֤ן לֹא־נָאוֶ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, So honour is not seemly for a fool.

verses.he: כַּצִּפּ֣וֹר לָ֭נוּד כַּדְּר֣וֹר לָע֑וּף כֵּ֥ן קִֽלְלַ֥ת חִ֝נָּ֗ם לא [ל֣וֹ] תָבֹֽא׃
verses.en: As the wandering sparrow, as the flying swallow, So the curse that is causeless shall come home. .

verses.he: שׁ֣וֹט לַ֭סּוּס מֶ֣תֶג לַחֲמ֑וֹר וְ֝שֵׁ֗בֶט לְגֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.en: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, And a rod for the back of fools.

verses.he: אַל־תַּ֣עַן כְּ֭סִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּ֑וֹ פֶּֽן־תִּשְׁוֶה־לּ֥וֹ גַם־אָֽתָּה׃
verses.en: Answer not a fool according to his folly, Lest thou also be like unto him.

verses.he: עֲנֵ֣ה כְ֭סִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּ֑וֹ פֶּן־יִהְיֶ֖ה חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.en: Answer a fool according to his folly, Lest he be wise in his own eyes.

verses.he: מְקַצֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַיִם חָמָ֣ס שֹׁתֶ֑ה שֹׁלֵ֖חַ דְּבָרִ֣ים בְּיַד־כְּסִֽיל׃
verses.en: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool Cutteth off his own feet, and drinketh damage.

verses.he: דַּלְי֣וּ שֹׁ֭קַיִם מִפִּסֵּ֑חַ וּ֝מָשָׁ֗ל בְּפִ֣י כְסִילִֽים׃
verses.en: The legs hang limp from the lame; So is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.he: כִּצְר֣וֹר אֶ֭בֶן בְּמַרְגֵּמָ֑ה כֵּן־נוֹתֵ֖ן לִכְסִ֣יל כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: As a small stone in a heap of stones, So is he that giveth honour to a fool.

verses.he: ח֭וֹחַ עָלָ֣ה בְיַד־שִׁכּ֑וֹר וּ֝מָשָׁ֗ל בְּפִ֣י כְסִילִֽים׃
verses.en: As a thorn that cometh into the hand of a drunkard, So is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.he: רַ֥ב מְחֽוֹלֵֽל־כֹּ֑ל וְשֹׂכֵ֥ר כְּ֝סִ֗יל וְשֹׂכֵ֥ר עֹבְרִֽים׃
verses.en: A master performeth all things; But he that stoppeth a fool is as one that stoppeth a flood.

verses.he: כְּ֭כֶלֶב שָׁ֣ב עַל־קֵא֑וֹ כְּ֝סִ֗יל שׁוֹנֶ֥ה בְאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: As a dog that returneth to his vomit, So is a fool that repeateth his folly.

verses.he: רָאִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Seest thou a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope of a fool than of him.

verses.he: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל שַׁ֣חַל בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ אֲ֝רִ֗י בֵּ֣ין הָרְחֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.en: The sluggard saith: ‘There is a lion in the way; Yea, a lion is in the streets.’

verses.he: הַ֭דֶּלֶת תִּסּ֣וֹב עַל־צִירָ֑הּ וְ֝עָצֵ֗ל עַל־מִטָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The door is turning upon its hinges, And the sluggard is still upon his bed.

verses.he: טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת נִ֝לְאָ֗ה לַֽהֲשִׁיבָ֥הּ אֶל־פִּֽיו׃
verses.en: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish; It wearieth him to bring it back to his mouth.

verses.he: חָכָ֣ם עָצֵ֣ל בְּעֵינָ֑יו מִ֝שִּׁבְעָ֗ה מְשִׁ֣יבֵי טָֽעַם׃
verses.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes Than seven men that give wise answer.

verses.he: מַחֲזִ֥יק בְּאָזְנֵי־כָ֑לֶב עֹבֵ֥ר מִ֝תְעַבֵּ֗ר עַל־רִ֥יב לֹּֽא־לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife not his own, Is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.

verses.he: כְּֽ֭מִתְלַהְלֵהַּ הַיֹּרֶ֥ה זִקִּ֗ים חִצִּ֥ים וָמָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: As a madman who casteth firebrands, Arrows, and death;

verses.he: כֵּֽן־אִ֭ישׁ רִמָּ֣ה אֶת־רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אָמַ֗ר הֲ‍ֽלֹא־מְשַׂחֵ֥ק אָֽנִי׃
verses.en: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, And saith: ‘Am not I in sport?’

verses.he: בְּאֶ֣פֶס עֵ֭צִים תִּכְבֶּה־אֵ֑שׁ וּבְאֵ֥ין נִ֝רְגָּ֗ן יִשְׁתֹּ֥ק מָדֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Where no wood is, the fire goeth out; And where there is no whisperer, contention ceaseth.

verses.he: פֶּחָ֣ם לְ֭גֶחָלִים וְעֵצִ֣ים לְאֵ֑שׁ וְאִ֥ישׁ מדונים [מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים] לְחַרְחַר־רִֽיב׃
verses.en: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; So is a contentious man to kindle strife.

verses.he: דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃
verses.en: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts of the body.

verses.he: כֶּ֣סֶף סִ֭יגִים מְצֻפֶּ֣ה עַל־חָ֑רֶשׂ שְׂפָתַ֖יִם דֹּלְקִ֣ים וְלֶב־רָֽע׃
verses.en: Burning lips and a wicked heart Are like an earthen vessel overlaid with silver dross.

verses.he: בשפתו [בִּ֭שְׂפָתָיו] יִנָּכֵ֣ר שׂוֹנֵ֑א וּ֝בְקִרְבּ֗וֹ יָשִׁ֥ית מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, But he layeth up deceit within him.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יְחַנֵּ֣ן ק֭וֹלוֹ אַל־תַּֽאֲמֶן־בּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י שֶׁ֖בַע תּוֹעֵב֣וֹת בְּלִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: When he speaketh fair, Believe him not; For there are seven abominations in his heart.

verses.he: תִּכַּסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה בְּמַשָּׁא֑וֹן תִּגָּלֶ֖ה רָעָת֣וֹ בְקָהָֽל׃
verses.en: Though his hatred be concealed with deceit, His wickedness shall be revealed before the congregation.

verses.he: כֹּֽרֶה־שַּׁ֭חַת בָּ֣הּ יִפֹּ֑ל וְגֹ֥לֵ֥ל אֶ֝בֶן אֵלָ֥יו תָּשֽׁוּב׃
verses.en: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein; And he that rolleth a stone, it shall return upon him.

verses.he: לְֽשׁוֹן־שֶׁ֭קֶר יִשְׂנָ֣א דַכָּ֑יו וּפֶ֥ה חָ֝לָ֗ק יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה מִדְחֶֽה׃
verses.en: A lying tongue hateth those that are crushed by it; And a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
